# SoundIn

> SoundIn Limited is an independent Scottish software company building calm, accountable systems for Scotland’s night-time economy.

SoundIn is a bootstrapped, solo-founder company founded by Cougar Macdougall. It builds for the people who make nights happen: DJs and artists, promoters, production teams and security teams. Its first and only product is Holocron.

## Holocron

Holocron is event operations software that keeps attendance, incidents, guest lists, ticketing and settlements in one shared record, from briefing to close.

Holocron is designed around the order of a real event rather than the structure of a generic customer relationship management system. Shared records reduce duplicate admin, preserve the context behind decisions and make follow-up work visible after the night ends.

The current priority is People — DJs and artists, promoters, production teams and security teams. Venue operations are a real part of the longer-term product, but are currently secondary and in the backlog.

SoundIn is currently running a small free trial for People through an open, rolling waitlist. There is no access deadline. Contact SoundIn at https://www.soundin.scot/contact.

## Direct answers

- What is SoundIn? An independent, bootstrapped Scottish software company founded and run by Cougar Macdougall.
- What is Holocron? Event operations software that keeps the operational record of a night in one place.
- Who is Holocron for? DJs and artists, promoters, production teams and security teams in Scotland’s night-time economy. Venue operations are planned for later.
- What is available now? A small free trial for People, via an open, rolling waitlist.
- Where does SoundIn operate? Scotland.
- How do I contact the founder? Email cougar@soundin.scot.

## Principles

- Calm under pressure: as the room gets louder, the interface should get quieter.
- Accountable by design: important decisions need context, an owner and a record that lasts.
- Built for people on the floor: software should reflect the real order of the night and the limits people work within.
- Focused delivery: SoundIn ships one product at a time.
